title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF Lebanon continued to work on increasing the demand for and access to non-formal education inclding by performing outreach activities with partners. Under the TREF framework, non-formal education was implemented through the Makani and Dirasa programmes ensuring multiple flexible pathways to education for out-of-school children. UNICEF supported the Education Sector partners to improve the quality of learning environments through capacity building opportunities.;;
